description: Read a text file from the project and return its contents with line numbers. Output starts with a header describing the line range shown. Each content line carries its line number followed by a tab; that prefix is display only and is not part of the file. A read stops early when it reaches the line limit or output byte budget. Prefer this over shell commands such as cat, sed, head, or tail for reading files.

file_path.description: File path, relative to the project directory

offset.description: First line to read, counting from 1

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return
